compatibility.summary: CheerpJ can run this game provided external dependencies or virtual filesystem assets are staged.
verified_capabilities: Accepts compiled binary JAR input directly without source code.

assumptions_and_risks: Browser audio autoplay policy requires user interaction before audio starts.
Direct disk file operations access in-memory CheerpOS virtual filesystem (data resets on refresh unless indexedDB persistence is configured).
workarounds_needed: Requires external NetBeans 'lib/AbsoluteLayout.jar' mounted into CheerpOS filesystem.
Ensure game startup waits for user click or initialize Web Audio context on user gesture.
remediation_steps: Bundle 'AbsoluteLayout.jar' and load it before launching the main JAR.

notes: Audio requires a browser user gesture. Some javax.sound.sampled / Clip formats may be unsupported by the browser backend.
